title: Turn on dynamic_pricing
author: kasia.brandt
body:
## Proposal

Flips the dynamic_pricing default on in production so rain surge pricing goes live for everyone instead of staying dark.

comments.author: dana.whitlock
comments.body: Product is keen to get this out -- any blockers?

comments.author: kasia.brandt
comments.body: Can we pin a review date for this one?

comments.author: mara.voss
comments.body: Blocking for now: legal still needs to sign off on rain surge pricing before this can go live in production, so the flag has to stay off until that review wraps up.
